title: Export Declarations for Textiles: CBIC Mandates Additional Qualifiers from Nov 1, 2026
content:
# Export Declarations for Textiles: CBIC Mandates Additional Qualifiers from Nov 1, 2026

Ek important update hai for all textile exporters! The Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) ne specific textile products ke export declarations mein mandatory additional qualifiers declare karne ke liye instructions announce kiye hain.

Here are the key details:

*   **Circular Number & Date:** CBIC ne Circular No. 42/2026-Customs dated September 24, 2026, issue kiya hai.
*   **Effective Date:** Yeh naye qualifiers November 1, 2026, se mandatory ho jayenge.
*   **What's New:** Exporters ko Customs Automated System mein Shipping Bill file karte waqt, certain woven and knitted fabrics ke liye additional qualifiers/identifiers provide karne honge.
*   **Affected Products:** Yeh requirement mainly Chapters 52, 55, aur 60 ke under classify hone wale textile products par lagoo hogi.
*   **Purpose:** The main aim is to electronically identify Fire/Flame Retardant (FR) textile products from non-FR ones. Aisa isliye zaroori hai kyunki existing tariff classification FR aur non-FR products ko distinguish nahi kar paati.
*   **Why it Matters:** This measure is crucial for the effective implementation of the Textiles Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme, ensuring proper identification for scheme benefits.
*   **Specific Qualifiers:** Exporters ko "CHR" Info Type Code ke saath "FR001" (Flame Retardant Fabric ke liye) ya "FR009" (Other than Flame Retardant Fabric ke liye) declare karna hoga.
*   **Legal Framework:** Yeh niyam Shipping Bill (Electronic Integrated Declaration and Paperless Processing) Regulations, 2019, ke provisions ke तहत laye gaye hain.
